caveats: Daily bulletin data interpolated to hourly; sub-daily peaks are smoothed.
Muskingum K and x for the Periyar reaches are geometry estimates, not gauge-calibrated. Downstream discharge figures are indicative.
Tariff values are indicative KSEB time-of-day bands, not a current KSERC order.
Energy-neutral rows cap mean turbine discharge at the observed mean, so the optimiser cannot book revenue the grid would not have taken. Quote these, not the unconstrained rows.
